'''Eleven Star Marketing''' was an advertising, marketing, and sales company active during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In this [[Time/Legends|time]], the company was a [[contributing sponsor]] to the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] (CSA), which meant that they had invested in the CSA and received discounts on raw materials sourced within the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] and a proportion of the [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] profits in return. They did not, however, have a voting position on the [[Executive Directorship Board]] that controlled the Corporate sector, for only selected contributing sponsors were given that privilege.<ref name="HSCS" />

By around [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="HSCSinterviewDate">Interviews with [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] in ''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]'' note a recent interaction between her and [[Salla Zend]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. That interaction occurs in ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'', which also depicts Organa Solo subsequently and directly traveling to the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] and [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates those events to [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], and as such, the interviews and information in the sourcebook presented as "current" must occur following the [[Battle of Calamari|events]] on Mon Calamari and thus around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> Eleven Star Marketing had worked with the company [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]] and created a very successful marketing campaign for Biotech's [[AJ^6 cyborg construct/Legends|Borg Construct Aj^6]] [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implant. The "Artificial Intelligence Worth Shaving Your Head For" campaign<ref name="HSCS" /> used emotive language to reinforce consumers' trust in the Biotech product and brand whilst sowing doubt and mistrust of competitors' products.<ref name="SWRPG2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eleven Star Marketing was first mentioned in the ''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]'', a [[1993]] supplement written by [[Michael Allen Horne]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="HSCS" /> The Borg Construct Aj^6 quote attributed to the marketing firm, however, first appeared alongside a more comprehensive advertisement in a previous West End Games sourcebook, ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition]]'' by [[Bill Smith]], published in [[1992]].<ref name="SWRPG2" />
